findings.title: Identical-concurrent pre-calls share pair_path via content hash, O_TRUNC overwrites first call_id
Existing settings.json with hooks as a JSON array causes jq reduce to emit numeric-string event keys, silently dropping user hooks
Lowercase compound env vars (db_password=) bypass both patterns — \b mismatch at underscore boundary
Shell-quoted secret values (DB_PASSWORD="my secret") excluded by value char class
os.open mode 0o600 silently ignored when pair file pre-exists; need fchmod for enforcement
Idempotency guard does not check Stop event; partial Stop-only install triggers re-merge that duplicates hooks
validate.sh log-recency false-WARN when log-rotate.sh has compressed today's .jsonl
